title.narrative: Dust and NOx reduction measures at TPP Kosovo B, Units B1 and B2

description.narrative: The overall objective is to improve air quality in Kosovo by reducing dust emissions from 300/700 mg/Nm³ down to 20 mg/Nm³ and NOx emissions from 700/850 mg/Nm³ down to 200 mg/Nm³ in line with the Directive on Large Combustion Plants (LCPD 2001/80/EC) and Industrial Emission Directive (IED 2010/75EU).

description.narrative: Dust emissions < 20 mg/Nm3197299
Dust emissions < 20 mg/Nm3The LCP and IE Directives require that dust emissions are less than 20 mg/Nm3.

comment.narrative: Measurement of dust emissions were conducted in September 2016 in TPP Kosovo B and recorded the average emission values of 243.31 809.67 mgNm3.
The LCP and IE Directives require that dust emissions are less than 20 mgNm3.

The design phase under this intervention is almost finished while the implementation of the works have not started yet therefore the current value is added the same as the value of the base date. The works contract under this intervention has been suspended since 11 February 2020 mainly due to the COVID pandemic force majeure event but also a few months due to some works that had to be arranged by the Beneficiary which works are closely related to the successful implementation of this intervention. Since April 2022 the contract has been suspended due to bankruptcy of one of the consortium partners and ongoing Judicial Reorganization ProcedureJRP.
